text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا يُؤْمِنُ أَكْثَرُهُم بِٱللَّهِ إِلَّا وَهُم مُّشْرِكُونَ

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening a fresh but connected diagnostic assertion
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the discourse over from the sign-scene of 12:105 into a fresh theological diagnosis. It joins the new clause to the prior censure, but its payoff is not merely additive: the same opening sound will be answered by the later circumstantial {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}), so the ayah moves from resumed observation to an internal state.

topics.headline: resumptive pivot into diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah begin as a connected answer to the prior sign-censure, not as a disconnected maxim.
topics.reason: The particle is licensed as a conjunction opening the negated verbal clause, and the CRITICAL rows converge on resumption from 12:105 into a universal diagnostic frame.

topics.headline: paired waw functions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated conjunction sound does two jobs: this one resumes the discourse, while the later one internalizes the state.
topics.reason: The first conjunction belongs to the main clause, while the later conjunction is analyzed as circumstantial; the contrast is locally supported by clause structure.

words.gloss_range: negating particle governing the imperfect belief verb and preparing restriction
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) denies an unqualified reading of the ongoing belief verb before the exception arrives. Its force is not simple absence: with {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}), it builds a restriction frame in which belief is acknowledged only under the later state of being {{ar:مُشْرِكُونَ}} ({{tr:mushrikūn}}).

topics.headline: present negation over imperfect belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the negation targets the ongoing quality of belief, not a closed past report.
topics.reason: The particle directly negates the imperfect verb in the main clause, supporting the CRITICAL claim about present, evaluated belief.

topics.headline: negation-exception restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes that the ayah is defining the only surviving mode of belief, not merely saying that most people do not believe.
topics.reason: The later exception particle and circumstantial clause are strongly licensed, so the negation prepares a restrictive architecture rather than a stand-alone denial.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect belief/trust directed by a bā-governed complement and qualified by the exception frame
words.root_gloss_range: safety, trust, security, and affirming belief; here narrowed to Form IV directed belief/trust toward God
words.prose: {{ar:يُؤْمِنُ}} ({{tr:yuʾminu}}) is the ayah's hinge. As a Form IV imperfect, it presents belief as an ongoing directed act, with {{ar:بِٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:bi-llāhi}}) preserving the target and the later exception qualifying the mode. Because the singular verb agrees with the collective head {{ar:أَكْثَرُهُمْ}} ({{tr:aktharuhum}}), the majority is first heard as one grammatical actor before the final plural predicate distributes the diagnosis. The root field adds trust and security pressure, but local form and grammar keep the selected sense at directed belief; that trust-bond is then exposed as compromised by simultaneous partner-assignment. The same root also turns forward in 12:107, where claimed belief is answered by a question about false security.

topics.headline: directed imperfect belief clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief is an ongoing act with a named target and an immediate restriction, not a vague religious label.
topics.reason: The verb is an IV imperfect with a bā-governed complement and an exception scope, so the CRITICAL grammar and valency claims are locally licensed.

topics.headline: singular verb with collective majority subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the majority handled as one grammatical subject before its members are diagnosed by the final plural predicate.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence identifies the following majority word as subject, and the singular verb agreement coheres with the collective elative head.

topics.headline: trust and security root pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels belief as a trust-bond toward God, while the local Form IV prevents replacing that with a bare safety sense.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL root-family rows preserve real trust and security pressure, but local morphology selects Form IV directed belief rather than the bare Form I sense of being safe.

topics.headline: belief formula complicated and carried forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that familiar belief-in-God language is reused in a marked way and then reopened as false-security language in 12:107.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete same-surah and cross-surah references, and the local clause indeed combines the familiar belief construction with the shirk qualifier.

words.gloss_range: elative majority with attached plural suffix, serving as the subject of the belief verb
words.root_gloss_range: abundance, increase, outnumbering, and majority; here narrowed to the greater part of an unnamed referent group
words.prose: {{ar:أَكْثَرُهُمْ}} ({{tr:aktharuhum}}) does more than count. The elative with its suffix makes the subject the greater part of an already implied group, and the singular verb treats that majority as one collective actor. Its abundance-root pressure makes the compromised belief feel prevailing, while the majority refrain (12:21; 12:38; 12:103) moves from not knowing and not thanking to the sharper diagnosis here: most believe only under the condition of shirk.

topics.headline: partitive majority as subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah speaks about the dominant part of a referent group, not an undefined “many.”
topics.reason: The word is tagged as an elative subject, and the suffix is locally tied to the later independent pronoun.

topics.headline: abundance root pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the majority as a swelling prevailing condition, while local form keeps the sense at “most of them.”
topics.reason: V4 preserves abundance and outnumbering branches for the root, but the local elative construction selects majority rather than wealth, boasting, or other branch senses.

topics.headline: majority refrain and boundary chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the majority-failure refrain (12:21; 12:38; 12:103) concentrating here into compromised belief.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cite concrete same-surah and cross-surah majority patterns, and the local suffix keeps the boundary plural connected to this subject.

words.gloss_range: preposition attaching the belief verb to its named object and preserving the target before restriction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: proper divine name as governed belief target

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}) makes the belief relation explicit by fastening the verb to {{ar:اللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāh}}) as its governed object phrase. That matters because the ayah does not erase the claimed relation to God; it lets the relation stand and then qualifies its condition through the exception clause. The fused phrase {{ar:بِٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:bi-llāhi}}) also turns the signs of 12:105 toward the God they claim to acknowledge.

topics.headline: governed belief target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the target of belief is grammatically explicit before the ayah exposes the compromised mode.
topics.reason: The preposition is syntactically forced as the governor of the divine-name complement, preserving the belief target while the exception qualifies the state.

topics.headline: fused attachment and sign boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the object phrase as tightly attached, while the prior signs become evidence pointing toward that named object.
topics.reason: The proclitic attachment is visible in the surface phrase, and the boundary row coherently links the prior signs to the present belief object without changing the local grammar.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as the governed target of belief, made sharper by the later shirk predicate
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine naming with worship and awe associations; local sense is the proper name, not a generic deity noun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: governing preposition before the divine name

words.prose: {{ar:اللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāh}}) fixes the belief relation on the proper divine name. The grammar makes the name the governed object of {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}), not part of the later predicate, so the shock is precise: the named One is acknowledged while partner-assignment still defines the same group. Worship and awe associations may color the name, but the local form remains the proper name rather than a common class noun. Same-surah links sharpen the contrast: non-association with God is declared in 12:38, and the call to God with disavowal of associators follows in 12:108.

topics.headline: proper divine target of belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the ayah is not about generic deity-belief but about acknowledgment of the proper divine name under a compromised state.
topics.reason: The noun is the governed complement of the preposition and is treated in the evidence as the proper divine name.

topics.headline: worship and awe pressure in the name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels why divided allegiance is jarring, while local grammar keeps the word as the proper divine name.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute and worship/awe field can color the name, but they do not replace the locally selected proper-name function.

topics.headline: belief and shirk meet at the divine name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices God as the relational center: the object of belief, the violated exclusivity, and the destination of the later call.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cite concrete same-surah relations at 12:38 and 12:108, and the local clause places belief in God before the shirk state.

words.gloss_range: exception and restriction particle introducing the circumstantial state clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negating particle that pairs with the exception
final state predicate governed by the restriction

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the hinge that prevents the first clause from settling as simple nonbelief or simple belief. With the earlier {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}), it restricts the surviving belief to one condition: belief occurs while the same people are {{ar:مُشْرِكُونَ}} ({{tr:mushrikūn}}). The particle can be heard through exception or restrictive manner, but the local ḥāl clause keeps the payoff stable: the ayah defines the quality of belief.

topics.headline: restrictive circumstantial hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the exception particle changes the issue from whether belief exists to what condition defines it.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence strongly licenses the following nominal sentence as the exception scope, supporting the CRITICAL restriction and ḥāl claims.

topics.headline: exception versus restrictive manner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can register the parse tension without letting it unsettle the local conclusion that belief is qualified by simultaneous shirk.
topics.reason: The rows preserve a real parse nuance, but both routes are narrowed by the same locally licensed circumstantial clause.

words.gloss_range: circumstantial conjunction attaching the nominal state to the belief clause as simultaneous
words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the ayah's simultaneity marker. It carries the following nominal sentence as a ḥāl state, so belief and shirk are not sequential stages but co-present conditions in the same subject. Its repeated sound also answers the opening {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}): the first joins the ayah to the prior discourse, while this one binds the inner diagnosis to the belief claim.

topics.headline: waw al-haal simultaneity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the state of shirk is simultaneous with belief, not a later event.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the nominal ḥāl sentence, and the attachment evidence explicitly analyzes the clause as circumstantial exception scope.

topics.headline: repeated waw and boundary frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated conjunction as cohesion while its function changes from discourse resumption to state-linking.
topics.reason: The two conjunctions occupy different licensed clause functions, and the boundary rows coherently connect the prior visible aversion to this inner state diagnosis.

words.gloss_range: independent plural pronoun starting the nominal state clause and repeating the earlier suffix referent

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: earlier majority expression resumed by the pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) makes the subject of the ḥāl clause explicit. The same group first appeared as the suffix in {{ar:أَكْثَرُهُمْ}} ({{tr:aktharuhum}}), then returns as an independent pronoun before the final predicate. That shift matters: the ayah does not assign belief to one group and shirk to another; it makes the same majority stand visibly under both descriptions.

topics.headline: explicit same subject of state clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that believers and associators are grammatically the same set.
topics.reason: The pronoun is the subject of the nominal ḥāl clause and is syntactically tied back to the majority subject.

topics.headline: suffix returns as independent pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the earlier suffix become an overt pronoun, tightening the identity chain.
topics.reason: The retained pronoun visibly repeats the earlier suffix referent and helps bind the circumstantial clause to the main clause.

words.gloss_range: Form IV active participle predicate naming an ongoing partner-assigning identity-state
words.root_gloss_range: sharing, partnership, association, partner-attribution, and related concrete branches; here narrowed to theological partner-assignment with partnership imagery still felt
words.prose: {{ar:مُشْرِكُونَ}} ({{tr:mushrikūn}}) is the diagnostic seal of the ayah. As a nominative plural active participle, it completes the nominal ḥāl clause as a standing identity-state, not a second event or an object of the belief verb. The root keeps the concrete image of sharing or partnership in the background, but local form and context narrow it to theological partner-assignment against the named relation to God. The ending also makes the state distributed across the majority, while same-surah echoes sharpen the indictment: 12:38 denies association with God, and 12:108 answers this label with disavowal of being among the associators.

topics.headline: nominal predicate identity-state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word as a stable state qualifying belief, not as a separate action or object.
topics.reason: The word is the nominative predicate of the nominal ḥāl sentence, and the active participle supports ongoing state rather than completed past event.

topics.headline: partner-allocation root image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels shirk as assigning a share or partner, while local context keeps the theological association sense selected.
topics.reason: V4 supports partnership and associating-with-God branches; the local participle selects theological partner-attribution while preserving the divided-allocation image.

topics.headline: group-bound participial form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the predicate applied across the collective as an ongoing plural identity, not as an abstract noun.
topics.reason: The masculine plural nominative participle agrees with the explicit pronoun and fits the active-participle profile rather than a completed finite form.

topics.headline: belief-shirk opposition and same-surah echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final predicate as the ayah’s closing indictment and as the foil for the non-shirk declarations at 12:38 and 12:108.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete references and the local structure pairs belief and shirk inside one subject, making the intertextual and structural payoff coherent.

topics.headline: sound and boundary pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final predicate arrive with heavier articulation and as an acoustic closure linked to the prior ayah.
topics.reason: The sound rows are concrete and locally tied to the pronoun-predicate boundary and adjacent participial closures, so they survive as a secondary payoff.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exception construction holds God-directed belief at word 2 and association at word 7 together as concurrent states.
baseline_models.mechanism: Heart-settling assent is present, but the divine relation is organized as shared participation. The focus diagnoses partitioned allegiance rather than simple absence of acknowledgment.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies a genuinely affirmative component rather than total unbelief.
The worship-and-object relation fixes God as the acknowledged divine referent.
Participation in a jointly held matter supplies the functional split of allegiance.
The theological branch bounds the sharing mechanism within association with God.

changed_reading.before: Most simply lack belief in God because they are associators.
changed_reading.after: Most retain real God-directed assent, but it operates inside a concurrently shared allocation of worship, reliance, or agency.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The belief verb at word 2 also carries security and trust, while word 7 names participation with another.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can be heard as a trust arrangement: God is a source of safety, but not the sole source. Association keeps supplementary guarantors inside the security system.

activation_trace.role: Settled safety and trust turn belief into an operative placement of security.
Joint participation distributes that security relation among multiple claimants.

changed_reading.before: Belief is only propositional acknowledgment, with association added as a separate doctrine.
changed_reading.after: Belief is also entrusted safety, and its defect is diversification across God and retained backups.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The majority quantifier at word 3 stands in the same clause as the shared-allegiance predicate at word 7.
baseline_models.mechanism: External numerical plurality and internal plurality of authority echo one another. Mass can stabilize a non-unitary judgment instead of evidencing truth.

activation_trace.role: Numerical overpowering makes majority status capable of functioning as social proof.
A judgment that is not one supplies the internal analogue to the external multitude.

changed_reading.before: The majority expression is only a statistic about how many associate.
changed_reading.after: Numerical mass can itself become a co-authority that keeps judgment divided.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding scene supplies visible signs, bodily passage, and a turned side. Its circumstantial posture repeats in the focus, converting association into an attentional mechanics: acknowledgment occurs without gaining the person's whole orientation.

activation_trace.role: An outwardly legible mark supplies evidence that can be encountered yet fail to govern attention.
Passing across something without stopping supplies the motion of incomplete uptake.
Turning one's side supplies the literal divided orientation internalized by the focus.
Affirmative assent explains how a sign may register without total reorientation.
Shared participation assigns the remaining orientation to competing claims.

structural_cues: 12:105 and 12:106 are adjacent and repeat a circumstantial frame in which an action coexists with an enduring plural state.
The sequence moves from passing while turned away to believing while associating, preserving simultaneity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel posture, signs, passage, side-turning, assent, and sharing; I infer that the bodily orientation models divided allegiance. Alternatively, the syntactic parallel may only accumulate charges.

changed_reading.before: Association adds another object to otherwise intact belief.
changed_reading.after: Association is also side-on belief: God and signs are acknowledged, yet competing orientations keep that acknowledgment from commanding the whole person.

context_deltas.mechanism: One root moves from experienced safety, through the focus belief verb, to challenged safety before an overwhelming sudden arrival. This activates the focus as a critique of insured belief whose supplementary protections generate misplaced security.

activation_trace.role: Concrete safety establishes the root's lived-security pole before the focus.
Settled security lets belief carry trust placement as well as assent.
Joint holding turns trust into a portfolio rather than exclusive entrustment.
The interrogated feeling of safety tests whether preceding belief actually secures.
An all-enveloping cover supplies the event that defeats partial protections.
Sudden onset removes time to recruit secondary safeguards.
Absent fine perception explains why felt security persists until surprise.

structural_cues: The security-belief root recurs at 12:99, 12:106, and 12:107 as safety, belief, and challenged safety.
The focus directly precedes a question exposing unperceived vulnerability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the root chain, sharing, cover, surprise, and non-perception; I add that retained partners function as risk hedges. Simple root polysemy without a portfolio relation remains live.

changed_reading.before: The focus only contrasts correct and incorrect propositions.
changed_reading.after: It may expose a security economy in which God is trusted while supplementary guarantors are retained, until sudden exposure overturns confidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next configuration is directional: one path, a Godward call, inward sight, and followers tracing behind. Transcendence and explicit non-association close it, making undivided belief aligned movement rather than isolated opinion.

activation_trace.role: Assent is the focus element converted by the next scene into directed practice.
Joint participation supplies the divided alternative to one directed course.
A traversable extended way gives exclusive belief a practical vector.
Calling and verbally inclining others supplies active Godward direction.
Inner sight makes the path knowingly oriented rather than inherited motion.
Tracing an effect step by step supplies coherent continuity for the followers.
Declaring transcendence removes divine agency from comparison with partners.
Explicitly negated partnership names this path as the focus countermodel.

structural_cues: 12:108 directly follows the focus and repeats its association root under first-person negation.
A singular path accommodates multiple followers without multiplying destination or authority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path, call, insight, following, transcendence, and non-association; I infer that they unpack the positive opposite of divided belief. Alternatively, they may describe only the messenger's commission.

changed_reading.before: Non-association merely subtracts extra objects from a creed.
changed_reading.after: Non-association positively aligns perception, speech, movement, and communal following on one Godward course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close opposes passing signs with looking, disciplined reasoning, trace-following story, case transfer, confirmation, and guidance. Belief becomes integrative evidence practice; association can include rival authorities fragmenting what evidence would join.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent is the focus outcome whose evidential formation is displayed later.
A non-unitary judgment supplies the failure mode of fragmented authority.
Directing outer or inner sight supplies deliberate inspection.
A faculty restraining ignorance turns observation into disciplined inference.
Following a footprint makes narrative evidence a traceable sequence.
Making one condition instruct another transfers story into present judgment.
Truth realized in promise and event supplies confirmation rather than bare assertion.
Gentle indication toward a way makes assembled evidence directional.
The returning belief root marks those for whom the evidence becomes operative.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from passing and turning at 12:105 to traveling, looking, and reasoning at 12:109.
12:111 closes with story, lesson, confirmation, detail, guidance, and mercy for a believing people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered cognitive and narrative operations; I infer that belief names their integrated uptake and association can name divided interpretive authority. They may instead be benefits received after belief.

changed_reading.before: Belief is a static proposition beside an added partner.
changed_reading.after: Belief also joins signs, aftermaths, and narrative traces into guidance; association leaves that integration answerable to competing authorities.

context_deltas.mechanism: After explicit exclusion from association, messengers are placed under exhausted hope and contested supposition before aid. Association therefore cannot collapse into every episode of epistemic or affective strain.

activation_trace.role: Settled assent supplies the state distinguished from temporary strain.
The theological branch defines the charge as assigning partnership.
Explicit non-association establishes status before the pressure scene.
Severed hope supplies severe affective pressure without adding a partner.
Doubt or conjecture supplies epistemic instability.
Attribution of falsehood intensifies the crisis of reception.
Manifesting aid resolves pressure without making prior strain association.

structural_cues: 12:108 rejects association, while 12:110 soon stages messengers at the limit of hope and amid disputed cognition.
Aid arrives after the pressure, preserving an interval of strained confidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-association, exhausted hope, supposition, falsehood, and aid; I infer that divided allegiance differs from faith under pressure. Pronoun and passive relations remain live, but either broad construal preserves strain before aid.

changed_reading.before: Any uncertainty inside belief is already the divided state condemned.
changed_reading.after: The condemned coexistence is divided allegiance or agency, not every passage through doubt, exhausted hope, or delayed confirmation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because a demographic quantifier becomes causal; valid through the focus majority and association words, numerical overpowering, and prior collective resolve. Render only as an exploratory social-authority layer, not lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus couples its majority quantifier at word 3 with association at word 7.

activation_trace.role: Joining others upon a matter supplies coalition as a producer of settled judgment.
Overpowering by number lets majority act as evidential pressure.
The same numerical force places social mass inside the diagnosis.
Joint participation lets the collective become a shareholding authority.
A judgment that is not one supplies the internal result of social coauthority.

changed_reading.before: Most individuals happen to hold an associating doctrine.
changed_reading.after: The majority may itself become a partner whose collective weight co-authors what counts as trustworthy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Branch-distant because it activates road-groove and hunter-net senses inside a theological predicate; valid because association is flanked by passing, path, and trace-following. Mark it as spatial-material analogy, never an ordinary lexical substitute.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The association predicate at word 7 carries routing and entanglement branches while belief at word 2 is the redirected motion.

activation_trace.role: Road grooves supply competing channels through which assent can be routed.
A hunter's device supplies belief caught before exclusive alignment.
Passing onward gives the routing image movement.
A traversable path supplies the unbranched counter-route.
Stepwise trace-following supplies disciplined movement beyond competing tracks.

changed_reading.before: Association is only conscious addition of another divine object.
changed_reading.after: At image level, Godward assent can enter inherited tracks and become caught or rerouted before reorganizing conduct.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because a human-directed bow appears near rejection of association; valid through the partnership charge and later allocation of guardianship, surrender, transcendence, and non-association. Use only as caution against classification by gesture alone; the bow's ritual status remains unresolved.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The theological-association branch at word 7 asks where ultimate worship and agency are allocated, not only which gesture is visible.

activation_trace.role: Assigning a divine partner supplies the category a gesture alone cannot settle.
Lowering the head supplies an embodied act whose theological allocation remains inferred.
Taking charge of an affair locates ultimate guardianship in the address to God.
Handing over supplies self-entrustment as deeper commitment.
Declaring God free of comparison supplies the theological boundary.
Explicit rejection of partnership shows that honor and divine association need not be mechanically identical.

changed_reading.before: Any lowered gesture toward another being mechanically proves association.
changed_reading.after: The deeper diagnostic is allocation of ultimate worship, guardianship, and agency; a social gesture may remain ambiguous.

strongest_changes: Adjacent circumstantial clauses recast association as divided orientation: signs register while the person remains turned elsewhere.
The safety-belief root chain activates belief as trust and association as protective backups exposed by sudden vulnerability.
The single-path configuration makes non-association an aligned practice of insight, call, and trace-following.
The closing evidence sequence distinguishes integrated belief from fragmented authority and temporary faith under strain.
summary.what_was_special: The exception preserves coexistence. Context spatializes it as side-turning and path choice, temporalizes it as security before surprise, socializes it as majority pressure, and tests it against strained but non-associating trust.
remaining_uncertainties: The safety sense is strongly activated by recurrence, but the portfolio-of-guarantors arrow remains abductive.
Majority-as-coauthority and routing-trap are live branch analogies, not lexical substitutions.
The 12:110 pronoun and passive relations remain unresolved, though strain still differs from partnership.
The nearby bow supports a gesture-versus-allocation distinction, but the packet does not settle its ritual classification.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Assent can coexist with divided participation.** ء م ن B002 and ش ر ك B001/B002 (sharing; associating a partner with God) are joined by the exception construction. The ayah preserves two concurrent states rather than treating belief and association as simple chronological opposites. I infer that acknowledgment may be real yet structurally partitioned.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:108 answered mixed association with an explicitly insight-based path and a direct disavowal of شرك.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Assent and association held together without being collapsed.** `ء م ن:B002` is trusting assent or confirmation, while `ش ر ك:B002` is assigning a partner to God, grounded in the shared participation of `ش ر ك:B001`. The exception construction does not replace belief with association; it states that most people's believing occurs while they are associating. The packet supplies coexistence in one subject and time; I infer that acknowledgment can be real yet structurally compromised by distributing what should not be shared. The ayah changes belief from a simple binary label into a relation whose internal allocation must be examined.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:108 explicitly disavows association while describing invitation upon insight, confirming that the coexistence diagnosed here is not normalized but answered by a route with a stated boundary.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı sözlük birimini cennetteki özel ırmak, bol ve büyük iyilik, ayrıca iyiliği ve bağışı bol cömert önder için kullanır. Dal bu sözlüksel çokanlamlılık olarak korunabilir; bu üç gönderim tek bir varlık tanımıymış gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Irmak, bol iyilik ve cömert kişi ayrı sözlüksel gerçekleşmelerdir; ortak bağları olağanüstü bolluk düşüncesidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın bir çokluk anlamı kurmak yerine verilen sözcük ve kişi kalıbına bağlı üç özel kullanımı ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Olağanüstü bolluk bildiren özel bir sözlük birimi, cennetteki bir ırmağı veya bol ve büyük iyiliği adlandırır; kişi kalıbında ise iyiliği ve bağışı bol, cömert bir önderi niteler.

facets.statement: Sözlük birimi cennette bulunan ve başka ırmakların kendisinden ayrıldığı özel bir ırmağı adlandırır.
Sözlük biriminin ortak çekirdeği, ırmak, iyilik ve kişi kullanımlarını olağanüstü bolluk düşüncesine bağlar.
Kişi kalıbında iyiliği ve bağışı çok, cömert ve önder bir erkek nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel sözlük birimini cennetteki bir ırmak ve bol ya da büyük iyilik olarak açıklar; kişi için kullanıldığında cömertliği, önderliği, iyilik ve bağış bolluğunu bildirir. Bir açıklamada cennet ırmaklarının çoğunun ondan ayrıldığı, bir diğerinde ise bol iyiliğin Peygamber'e verildiği belirtilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözlük biriminin iki temel açıklamasını birlikte gösterir; kişi nitelemesi ayrıca bağlama bağlıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Özel ırmak ile bol iyilik açıklamalarını ayrı seçenekler olarak korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yoğunlaşıp yükselen tozu adlandıran özel kullanımla bir şeyin son derece çoğalmasını bildiren biçimi birlikte verir. Ortak aşırı çokluk bağı dalı korur, ancak toz görüntüsü genel çoğalma anlamının zorunlu parçası değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Toz kullanımı yükselme veya kabarma görüntüsüne bağlıdır; genel biçim ise yalnız aşırı derecede çoğalmayı bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, toza bağlı kalıbı ve genel aşırı çoğalma biçimini ayrı yüzler olarak tutar; toz özelliğini yalın çoğalma anlamına taşımaz.

concept_map.definition: Toz kalıbında, çok olup kabaran veya havada belirgin biçimde yükselen yoğun tozu anlatır. Ayrı bir biçimde ise herhangi bir şeyin son derece çoğalmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek olağanüstü çokluktur; toz kalıbında bu çokluk kabarıp havada yükselen yoğun bir görünüm alır.
Toz dışındaki bir şey için kullanılan biçim, onun aşırı ve son sınıra varan ölçüde çoğalmasını bildirir.
Ölüm sahnesindeki tozun kabarıp çoklaşması, yoğun toz kullanımına örnek oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, çokluğu yüzünden kabarıp yükselen yoğun tozu ve bir şeyin son derece çoğalmasını aynı aşırılık alanında birleştirir; kabaran ölüm tozu bu kullanıma örnek verilir.

Bir ceza sözünde bu hurma ürünü, meyveyle birlikte el kesme cezasının uygulanmadığı şeyler arasında anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar adı çoğunlukla hurma ağacının iç göbeği ve çekilen öz bölümü için verir; bir açıklama çiçek salkımının ilk oluşumunu da kapsar ve yaygın bir sözde meyveyle birlikte anılır. Ad için kaynaklarda birden fazla harekeleme ve okunuş biçimi de aktarılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi avın içine dolanıp kaldığı avcı kapanını açıkça tanımlar ve dünya için kurulan tuzak benzetmesini buna bağlar. Geçici çerçevedeki belirli bir kuş için kurulma ayrıntısı yetkili dal ifadesinde bulunmadığından tanıma alınmamıştır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, avın yakalandığı bağ veya ağ biçimli kapan; genişleme ise bunun tuzak anlamındaki benzetmesidir. Belirli bir av türü zorunlu değildir.

facets.statement: Avcı, avın içine dolanıp yakalandığı bağ veya ağ biçimli bir kapan kurar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, avın dolanarak yakalandığı avcı kapanıdır; toplu ifade ayrıca bu kapan görüntüsünün dünyaya ilişkin tuzak benzetmesine genişlediğini gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki özel yapıda aynı ardışıklık niteliğini verir: hızlı ve peş peşe gelen tokatlar ile bir gelişin ardından gelen başka geliş. Dalın art arda oluş kimliği, bu yapılara bağlı tutulduğu sürece kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız belirtilen tokatlama ve geliş sırası kullanımlarında art ardalığı bildirir; yalın ve genel bir süreklilik sözü olarak genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalnız belirli niteleme yapılarında tanıklanmıştır; tanım art ardalık çekirdeğini korurken onu yalın kökün bağımsız anlamı saymaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli niteleme yapılarında bir vuruşun veya gelişin ardından benzerinin peş peşe gelmesini anlatır. Tokatlarda hızlılık da bu ardışıklığa eşlik eder.

facets.statement: Benzer olaylar biri diğerinin ardından art arda gerçekleşir.
Tokatlama bağlamında vuruşların peş peşe gelmesine hızlılık niteliği de eklenir.
Başka bir özel kullanımda bir suya gelişin ardından yeni bir gelişin gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak ifadesi art arda gelme niteliğini hızlı tokat dizisi ve bir gelişten sonra gelen başka geliş örnekleriyle sınırlandırılmış biçimde sunar.

concept_gloss.text: özel yapılarda hızlı ve art arda oluş
concept_gloss.applicability: Peş peşe tokatları ve birbiri ardından gerçekleşen gelişleri ortak ardışıklık niteliği altında açıklamak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yapıya bağlılığı, peş peşe oluşu ve tokat bağlamındaki hızlılığı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tokatların kısa aralıklarla peş peşe geldiği özel vuruş nitelemesinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Tokatların hızlı ve peş peşe gelmesini tam olarak korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir gelişin ardından başka gelişin olması kullanımını kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir ortak görüşü değil, kaygılı biri gibi kendi kendine konuşan kişiyi ve tek çizgide olmayan, bölünmüş görüşü anlatan iki kullanımı birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dal, paylaşılan görüş olarak değil iç konuşma ve görüş birliğinin bozulmasıyla ilişkili iki yapı olarak yeniden çerçevelenmiştir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, kişi için kaygılı iç konuşma ve görüş için tek olmama niteliklerini ayırır; insanlarca birlikte benimsenen ortak görüş anlamını taşımaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal kişi ve görüş hakkında kullanılan iki bağlı yapıyı ayırır; ikisi de yalın kökün genel ortaklık anlamına dönüştürülmez.

facets.statement: Kişi, kaygılı biri gibi kendi kendine konuşur ve iç düşüncesiyle meşgul görünür.
